changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Map') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Map]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Transformation] [nvarchar](4000) NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Map_CreatedBy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_Map_CreatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Map_UpdatedBy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_Map_UpdatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [MapTypeID] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Map_MapTypeID] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Map] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Map_MapType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Map] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Map_MapType] FOREIGN KEY([MapTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[MapType] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Map] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Map_MapType] END
